mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are overcast at Verona Community Park, and we have a full moon tonight. The temperature is 87 degrees, cooling down to an overnight low of 67 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city has two major updates today. First, road surface treatment is scheduled from August 4 through August 7 starting on Lincoln Street, so expect no parking signs. Second, the city offers a 100 dollar rebate for residents who replace old toilets with high-efficiency models, along with a rain barrel rebate program.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy free music at Century School Park, or head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia. Tomorrow, live music returns with performances at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly look at noteworthy calls, on July 26, officers arrested a driver for an O W I after she was clocked traveling 97 miles per hour on US Highway 18 and 151.

Cool down today with the delicious Caramel Turtle flavor of the day at Culver's, which is open until 10 PM. You can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park until 4:30 PM or at McGaw Park until 7 PM for some extra summer fun.
